3734-4808-4812-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {3}{U/P}, causing it to enter as an artifact copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Animate Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

618-997-1916.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Changeling Titan.
When the Changeling Titan token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Changeling Titan token.
When the Changeling Titan token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

586-678-2438.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Repeat.

549-3899-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-3899-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Repeat from step 3.
549-3899-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

2586-3197-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2113-3249-6887--52.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2113-3249-6887--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Skullspore Nexus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-6553-7424.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2999-3967.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2999-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

654-3129-4772-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

851-4826-6441-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

803-2511-3413.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Arcane Adaptation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1742-5003-5256-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-5003-5256-7848.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 three additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
1742-5003-5256-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

876-5821-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Fyndhorn Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Fyndhorn Elder.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Fyndhorn Elder.
Activate Fyndhorn Elder by tapping it, adding {G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Fyndhorn Elder.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Fyndhorn Elder.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Fyndhorn Elder from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1368-3755-5223-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-5223-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

924-1849-4149-4599-4871.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-1849-4149-4599-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-1849-4149-4599-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-1849-4149-4599-4871.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

2624-4875-5256-5659.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing God-Eternal Oketra.
When God-Eternal Oketra dies, it triggers, putting itself from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill cards equal to God-Eternal Oketra's power, which will cause you to mill God-Eternal Oketra.
As God-Eternal Oketra is a Lhurgoyf due to Conspiracy, Disa's first ability triggers, returning God-Eternal Oketra from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2103-3227-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Scrivener
When the Scrivener token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-719-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-2921.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

944-1020-2866-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {R}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Planar Gate.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {R}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Planar Gate.
Repeat.

730-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1305-4013-7009.manaNeeded: {2}{C} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1305-4013-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk. Choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability given to it by Barbara Wright.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

4771-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
4771-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

270-3918-4038.description:
Activate Trazyn using Hedron Archive's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

4186-4476-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4476-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

64-3542-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
64-3542-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Warden of the Eye and Palinchron, targeting Warden of the Eye
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the Warden of the Eye token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Warden of the Eye and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

2921-3951-5703-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
2921-3951-5703-5929.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

4050-4200-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Icewind Stalwart.
4050-4200-6132.description:
Cast Icewind Stalwart by paying its mana cost.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Icewind Stalwart.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Icewind Stalwart from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-3143-5696-6170.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-5696-6170.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Khalni Heart Expedition trigger.
Resolve the Khalni Heart Expedition trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

658-1453-1545-4438-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Urza's Saga has two lore counters on it.
Lands you control except Urza's Saga can tap to produce at least {2}.
The number of artifacts you control plus Arwen's toughness is equal to or greater than 9.
658-1453-1545-4438-4613.description:
Activate any number of lands except Urza's Saga by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Urza's Saga's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control, and that enters the battlefield with a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Arwen's toughness.
When the Construct enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain at least 10 life.
Activate the Construct using Beledros Witherbloom's ability by paying 10 life, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
If other lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

947-1132-1305-1469.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress' second ability triggers,  either causing it to become a copy of Widespread Thieving until end of turn if you aren't the monarch, or creating a token copy of Widespread Thieving if you are the monarch.
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving and either Court of Vantress or the Widespread Thieving token trigger, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat from step 2 until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

824-2034-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch and Leech Bonder do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent controls a creature.
824-2034-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch and Leech Bonder as attackers.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto another creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

628-2899-3983-4907.description:
Cast Tatterkite by paying {3}.
Tatterkite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Tatterkite's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero +1/+1 counters on it due to its effect.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will draw the game if it isn't interacted with.

643-2034-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-2034-4302.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.
